prompt:
A high-fidelity WEBSITE DESIGN COMP: a flat, screen-accurate rendering of a desktop web page at 1440px wide, viewed perfectly straight-on. No device frame, no browser chrome, no mouse cursor, no perspective tilt, no drop shadow around the page. This is a UI LAYOUT, not an illustration and not a poster: every region is a real page region with real typography at real, readable sizes and real alignment to a grid. Landscape 16:10, filling the frame edge to edge.

VISUAL WORLD — fixed, do not reinterpret, do not add to:
- Ground: rain-black, #07090D to #0D1420. Wet, deep, matte.
- Primary accent: one scarlet, #E6202C. This is the only accent on interface elements: the primary button, key rules, active ticks.
- Signage-only colours: magenta #FF2F7F and cyan #26D4EC. These appear ONLY inside the photographic city imagery as lit signs and reflections. They NEVER touch interface text, buttons, tables, or labels.
- Text: off-white #E8E6E1 for primary, concrete grey #7A8089 for secondary.
- Display type: very condensed, heavy, uppercase industrial signage lettering, tight tracking, slightly screen-printed / grainy edges.
- Label and body type: a technical monospace, small, uppercase for labels, wide letter-spacing.
- Materials: wet asphalt reflections, dense stacked vertical signage, hazard chevron stripes in off-white and black, riveted metal plates, hairline rules.

THE CRITICAL RULE OF THIS DESIGN: the neon and the glow live ONLY in the photographic imagery. Every region that carries data, specs, tables, or running text is a CALM, matte, near-black plate with crisp off-white type and at most a scarlet hairline or tick. There is no glow, no bloom, and no gradient haze behind any text. A spec table in this design is quiet and perfectly legible.
PAGE STRUCTURE, top to bottom — build the layout in exactly this order and these proportions:

1. THIN TOP BAR, about 4% of the height. Rain-black, a scarlet hairline along its bottom edge. Far left: a small scarlet geometric mark plus the wordmark SHADOWORD in condensed uppercase, letter-spaced. Far right, in small mono uppercase: LINUX FIRST, then OFFLINE BY DEFAULT, then a scarlet outlined button reading READ THE SOURCE.

2. HERO, about 68% of the height, full-bleed photographic night-city imagery. A symmetrical one-point-perspective view straight down a narrow wet city canyon at night. Both side walls are densely packed with lit vertical signage in magenta and cyan, stacked glyph panels, cables, air-conditioning units, fire escapes. Rain-slick asphalt in the lower third mirrors all of it in broken vertical streaks. Red taillight streaks sweep in from the lower left.
   At the DEAD CENTRE of the perspective, at the end of the canyon, stands one monolithic dark tower that is the ONLY unlit structure in the entire image — no signage, no windows lit, a black slab. A single narrow scarlet vertical line of light rises from its roof to the top of the hero. It is visibly sealed and separate from the lit city around it.
   Over the left half of this imagery, the headline in colossal condensed heavy uppercase off-white lettering, three lines, left-aligned, occupying roughly 40% of the hero width:
   SPEECH TO TEXT
   THAT NEVER LEAVES
   YOUR MACHINE
   Directly beneath the headline, one line of mono in concrete grey: LINUX FIRST. LOCAL WHISPER BY DEFAULT. YOU CHOOSE THE MODEL AND THE SILICON.
   Beneath that, side by side: a solid scarlet rectangular button with off-white mono uppercase reading READ THE SOURCE, and beside it plain mono grey text reading BUILD FROM SOURCE — NO PACKAGES YET.
   At the lower right of the hero, over the imagery, a small dark riveted metal plate with hazard chevrons along its top edge, carrying in mono: PUSH TO TALK, a large scarlet key glyph reading F2, and below it HOLD TO CAPTURE.

3. MODE STRIP, about 7% of the height, a calm matte near-black band with a scarlet hairline above it, NO imagery and NO glow. Three equal cells divided by hairlines, each with a small square indicator and mono uppercase labels: OFF, then LOCAL with its indicator lit scarlet and a thin scarlet underline marking it as selected, then REMOTE. Under each label a single short line of small grey mono text.

4. SECOND FOLD BEGINS, the bottom 21%, cropped by the frame edge. A calm matte near-black region, no imagery. On the left, a small scarlet mono label reading SIGNAL PATH above a large condensed uppercase off-white heading reading NOTHING IS TRANSCRIBED SPECULATIVELY. To its right, four numbered columns divided by hairline rules, each with a large outlined mono numeral and a condensed uppercase label: 01 CAPTURE, 02 SEGMENT, 03 COMMIT, 04 DELIVER, each with two lines of small grey mono text beneath, and the 03 COMMIT column marked with a scarlet tick.

TEXT: render every word listed above exactly and spelled correctly. Do not invent any other words, numbers, benchmarks, percentages, prices, star counts, or testimonials anywhere in the image. Any lettering inside the photographic city signage is decorative and must not read as English claims.

DO NOT: add a browser window, tab bar, URL bar, or window controls. Do not tilt or angle the page. Do not put glow, bloom, or coloured haze behind any interface text. Do not let magenta or cyan appear on any button, label, table, or rule.
